svg.data-what: the lungs and airways seen from the front: the right lung, with three lobes, is on the left of the picture

path.data-what: the upper lobe of the right lung
the middle lobe of the right lung, the right lung only has one
the lower lobe of the right lung
the upper lobe of the left lung, with the notch where the heart lies and the tongue-like lingula below it
the lower lobe of the left lung
the fissures, the clefts that divide the lungs into lobes: three on the right, two on the left

g.data-what: the diaphragm, the dome of muscle under the lungs: it flattens to draw air in
the bronchial tree, the airways branching again and again inside the lungs down to the bronchioles

path.data-what: the right main bronchus: shorter, wider and steeper than the left, so inhaled objects often go right
the left main bronchus, longer and more horizontal, passing under the aortic arch

g.data-what: the trachea, the windpipe, kept open by C-shaped rings of cartilage
